params.body:
Two of the four ledgers were scheduled (`security-fix`, `maintenance`). The headers hand's first claim on portal, merged and live, stayed `unjudged` for that reason alone; running `elixir:judge headers` by hand confirmed it at once ("3 header(s) now sent").

A playbook whose runs are never judged keeps a record of nothing, and a record of nothing never earns a rung. So: `major-upgrade` at 07:17, `headers` at 07:18, and a test that walks the four hands and asks whether each ledger is on the clock. Checked that it bites by removing the headers line.
params.title: Every ledger has its judge on the clock
